headline: NGO Program Assistant
summary: Program assistant with three years at an NGO running water, sanitation and livelihood projects in Oriental Mindoro. I coordinate activities with barangay partners, keep beneficiary records and project files, and prepare monitoring reports from our field data.
skills: Community engagement with barangays and Mangyan communities

experience.title: Program Assistant
bullets: Coordinate schedules, suppliers and barangay partners for 14 water system and livelihood projects.
Organise community meetings and consultations with Mangyan leaders.
Keep beneficiary lists and household profiles complete for about 1,200 families.
Analyse monitoring data in Excel and draft quarterly reports for two donors.
Maintain the project filing system for contracts, receipts and photos.

experience.title: Field Enumerator
bullets: Interviewed households for a nutrition survey and checked forms for completeness.
Encoded survey results for the analysis team.

education.credential: Bachelor of Arts in Development Studies
education.school: Oriental Mindoro College of Arts and Sciences
